news.title: ビットコインの実現損失が降伏水準、鍵となる価格帯を分析＝グラスノード
news.summary: グラスノードは仮想通貨週間レポートを発表。ビットコインの実現損失が過去の底値圏で見られた水準に達し、レバレッジも解消されたと報告。一方で需要は弱いとしている。

news.title: 予測取引でビットコインを担保に、アンカレッジがカルシにサービス提供
news.summary: アンカレッジ・デジタルがカルシ・プライムと提携し、機関投資家が保管中のビットコインとステーブルコインを証拠金として使えるようになった。資産の売却や送金をせず、保管先を変えずに取引できる。

news.title: ビットコイン週間12％安、ビットワイズCIOは金利ショックを主因に
news.summary: ビットワイズのホーガンCIOは、前週のビットコイン12％安の主因を10月の米CPI上振れによる金利ショックと分析した。12月利上げ確率は100％に上昇し、週末には約20億ドルが清算。ショックは一巡したとみる根拠を伝える。

news.title: メタプラネット傘下入り予定の米スーパーリーグ、8ビットコインを追加購入
news.summary: メタプラネットの傘下入りを控える米スーパーリーグが16日、13日に8BTCのビットコインを平均約6万8,948.90ドルで購入したと開示した。購入量は前回の16BTCのビットコインの半分だった。

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: 米最大手ビットコイン現物ETF、11営業日続いた資金引き揚げから一転　慎重な見解も
news.summary: ブラックロックのビットコイン現物ETFが16日、11営業日続いた資金流出を食い止め、7,650万ドルの純流入となった。しかし、1日の流入だけで市場の回復とみるのは時期尚早との指摘も。

news.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
news.summary: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

news.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
news.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

news.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
news.summary: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

news.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? ‘Almost certainly not,’ says Dragonfly’s Qureshi
news.summary: Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.

news.title: ARK sells $85M in Nvidia shares ahead of chipmaker’s Q3 earnings results
news.summary: ARK bought shares in Block, Circle and Coinbase worth about $39.9 million at Monday’s close while selling Nvidia and Solana and Ether staking ETFs.

news.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
news.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

news.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
news.summary: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

news.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
news.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

news.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

news.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
news.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

news.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
news.summary: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks continue slump as Huang signals interest in returning to Nvidia
news.summary: The Fed's hawkish rhetoric continued on Tuesday, with St. Louis Fed President Musalem arguing for several rate hikes before next spring. Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low.

news.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
news.summary: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

news.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
news.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

news.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
news.summary: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

news.title: ビットコイン含み益比率、52％に低下　過去1年有数の下げ幅＝アナリスト
news.summary: クリプトクアント認定アナリストのアドラーJr.氏が分析。ビットコインの供給のうち含み益にある割合は1週間で7ポイント下がり52％に。長期保有者の保有量も90日来の低水準となり、含み益と含み損の分岐点が近づく。

news.title: 「ビットコインのスーパーサイクルは健在」資産運用大手のストラテジストが強調
news.summary: カナダの資産運用会社のストラテジスト、ジェームス・ソーン氏は直近の急落後もビットコインへの強気姿勢を維持している。ファンダメンタルズに変化はないとし、ビットコインのスーパーサイクルは崩れていないと強調した。

news.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
news.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

news.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
news.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.
